# Dependency overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, which is vulnerable; the first patched
# release is 1.30.0. semgrep.txt is installed with --no-deps, so the exact pin is never
# re-checked at install time. Pinned exactly (not >=) so the lock stays close to the
# version semgrep was released against. Drop this once semgrep ships with mcp >= 1.30.0.
mcp==1.30.0
# GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h: semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37.0 (unbounded tracestate parsing,
# fixed in 1.45.1). The SDK, exporter and instrumentation packages pin the API exactly, so the
# whole OpenTelemetry family moves together to the 1.45.1 / 0.66b1 release. Same --no-deps
# reasoning as above. Drop these once semgrep allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.1
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b1
